Scripts

Effects

An effect is an HTML page of the theme, with its scripts, drawn as a layer: particles, shaders, a canvas, anything.

"effects": [
  { "id": "stars", "src": "effects/stars.html", "layer": "back" }
]

layer: back over the background and under the screens (the default), front over the screens, top over everything, the menus too. An effect never takes the pointer nor the joypad. It knows what happens:

<canvas id="c"></canvas>
<script>
  // rp is always there: the app puts it in first
  rp.on('press', ({ action }) => pulse())             // any button
  rp.on('focus', (f) => f?.game && tint(f.game.hue))   // the game with the focus
  rp.on('screen', ({ tab, screen }) => …)              // what is shown
  rp.on('launch', (l) => l && l.state === 'started' && …)
  rp.ready.then(() => draw(rp.options))
</script>

Neon Arcade’s neon grid and Horizon’s light in the air are effects: duplicate them to see how.
